messages:
Maria Chen: Morning — quick async pulse from infra/runtime side:
Maria Chen: Yesterday: finished the KV cache eviction bugfix (PR #4123) and validated on staging — latency tail dropped ~18%.
Maria Chen: Blockers: hitting a rare OOM in long-chat tests when batch size > 48, still reproducing locally; need help from infra team to triage memory graphs.
Maria Chen: Today: run longer load tests with different batching profiles, open a follow-up PR with extra GC guardrails, and prep notes for postmortem if it recurs.
Jamal Rivera: Nice! I can pair on the memory traces after lunch. Where are you dumping the pmap logs?
Maria Chen: @Jamal they land in /mnt/logs/kv-evict/ on the staging instance — `kv_evict_trace.log` has the heap snapshots.
Sophia Patel: From front-end: merged the streaming hookup for tool-calls UI (PR #587) — minor styling follow-up incoming. No blockers.
Alex Huang: Quick ask for eng: can someone review my rollout config for dedicated pools? It's in `infra/rollouts/dedicated.yaml` — PR #4180. Need approval to schedule canary tomorrow.
Li Wei: I can review #4180 this afternoon, ping me when it's ready.
Infra Bot: Scheduled job `nightly-load-test` started (ID: nl-2026-03-17-07) — ETA 4h.
deploy-bot: Release v1.14.2 deployed to staging — commit a9f3c2e — smoke tests passed :white_check_mark:
Jamal Rivera: For the OOM: try reducing the prefetch window and enable per-request cache eviction (flag `--evict-on-end`). Might help narrow repro.
Maria Chen: Good call, will toggle `--evict-on-end` and re-run. Thanks @Jamal.
Sophia Patel: FYI product asked for a short note about latency improvement to include in customer digest — @Maria can you drop a 1-2 line summary when you have numbers?
Maria Chen: Sure — will paste metrics once the long-run completes.
Alex Huang: Also heads-up: codeowners pinged for CR on model-routing change — would appreciate an extra set of eyes from runtime folks.
Li Wei: On it, will do a pass before EOD.
Maria Chen: TL;DR — recent KV cache fix live on staging, investigating intermittent OOM on long chats, can we get triage help from infra today? Thanks all :v:
